title: The Landfall of Mount Kessler
author: Freya Joubert
blurb: Silas Pemberton, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
